items.title: The 27 tracks Verstappen has won at after Singapore triumph
items.content: Max Verstappen triumphed in Singapore with Red Bull at the weekend, to take his maiden Grand Prix win at the Marina Bay Street Circuit. The Dutchman won at his 10th attempt under the lights of F1’s original night race at the end of an incredible weekend for the four-time World Champion that included the win in the Sprint too.

items.title: Inside Rwanda’s plan for the African Grand Prix
